description: Steward of the Geng house. Forties, grey at the temple. Twenty years with the family. The face of a man who has slept in pieces for six weeks. Tang: "the look of a man carrying a table on his own."
knows: that Xu Ping can smell something from the gutter he cannot name — Xu Ping told him all of it, at the gate, truthfully
last_seen: his own doorway, at the second drum
name: Pei
not_knows: that he followed the musk delivery
that he knelt at the east wall
observed_not_explained: Before refusing, before asking anything else, he said: "Did he send you?"
toward_player: Refused him at the gate and barred it. Not hostile. Rehearsed.
voice: Says "the house" where another man would say we, or the family. Never opens a door more than the width of his own shoulder.
